elevation.comment: Box-shadow tokens per surface level. Dark theme uses deeper shadows; light theme uses subtle ones.

1.comment: Subtle touch-point shadow — ticket card, minimal elevation

2.comment: Card edge. Light uses two layers — a 1px contact shadow that draws the edge plus a soft ambient one for depth; the single 12px/7% blur read as a smudge, not a lift. Dark keeps the flat blur: there the edge comes from the surface step, not the shadow.
